visualCharacteristics.purpose: brand-category cards, each with title, description and a grid of linked brand logos
visualCharacteristics.layout: four columns on desktop, stacking on smaller screens; logos in a 3-up grid under the text

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: optional cell 1 image; cell 2 title heading, description paragraph, then paragraphs of linked logo images (gathered into the logo grid)

cells: Optional eyebrow, title heading, description, CTA link (or linked logo images for cards-logo-grid)

usage: Brand portfolio ribbon (Luxury, Full Service, Select Service, Longer Stays).
reuseGuidance: Likely site-wide; author the section once as a fragment and reference it. For plain logo strips without card text, a single card row also works.
